tool_args.rationale: The observations change from positive at short horizons to negative at long horizons, matching the archived endogenous-adaptation law. Numerically fit its four parameters with positive, ordered time scales and request fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; its three long-horizon observations expose the reversal and constrain slow adaptation.
These do not explain the observed positive short-horizon response followed by negative long-horizon response as naturally as the archived dual-horizon mechanism.
The eight existing observations cover both time scales and support the simpler archived dual-exponential mechanism; an additional probe is not currently necessary.
